conclusion: The default Agentd owners cannot currently supply a complete authenticated CurrentMemoryRetrievalContext. No production provider was added: doing so now would require inventing external currentness or adding unused forwarding interfaces. Existing HnmfRequired failure and all generation/revocation checks remain intact.

only_concrete_provider.semantics: Test-only fixture returns first/later captured contexts using an atomic call counter; rejects an unexpected owner/body generation. It does not authenticate or read live external owners.
only_concrete_provider.fixture_fields: Lines 143-190 use a fixture external digest for encoder/model/tokenizer/template/tool-schema, literal compact/prompt/authority generations, and an explicitly fabricated test Engram node. These values cannot be promoted into production currentness.

existing_real_sources.semantics: body_generation is the original spawn generation. CognitiveContext and final-use revalidation pass identity.spawn_generation; lifecycle authority is independently refreshed before and after I/O. The provider must not substitute the current lifecycle generation for body identity.

lane_c_snapshot obtains a real read transaction; DurableCognitiveSnapshot exposes owner frontiers and scope. bind_context checks all five cognitive-owned frontier/generation values and scope exactly. Snapshot digest/cut digest alone do not authenticate external owners or anti-rollback currentness.

composition_and_consistency_gaps.name: Existing constructor precedes the real owner objects
composition_and_consistency_gaps.detail: with_cognitive_retrieval_context calls current() immediately; runtime requires the provider before AgentdState::new opens the prompt owner and before CognitiveStore is opened/attached. A provider backed by those exact default owners needs an explicit composition point after their construction and before control sockets/tasks/admission. A forwarding placeholder installed early would not solve this.

composition_and_consistency_gaps.name: No request/turn model identity in the current provider contract
composition_and_consistency_gaps.detail: current(owner, body_generation) is body-scoped. CognitiveContext carries no thread/run/model identity. A complete implementation must either enforce one immutable authenticated profile for the entire body or add a versioned request-scoped binding; it cannot guess which concurrent App Server turn/model/objective a query belongs to.

composition_and_consistency_gaps.name: Cross-owner atomicity/currentness must be explicit
composition_and_consistency_gaps.detail: Every external component and Engram must bind the same full vector. The consumer already revalidates the SQLite cut, re-reads the provider and compares binding_digest before publishing, and re-reads it again at final use. A new provider must observe monotone/current owner heads and fail on changes/revocation; caching a captured struct forever would defeat those existing checks.

composition_and_consistency_gaps.name: Bounded synchronous I/O remains the provider's obligation
composition_and_consistency_gaps.detail: The trait is synchronous and load_retrieval_context runs it via spawn_blocking without an enclosing I/O timeout. A future real provider must bound each owner read and return unavailable on blocked/poisoned/revoked sources. No runtime test of a real provider exists in this cohort.

smallest_safe_follow_on: First supply actual model/encoder, compact, objective/authority, and Engram current-owner contracts. Their successful construction and recovery must provide observable identities, not just caller-provided Digest32 values.
Expose a bounded read snapshot from the existing AgentdPromptPipelineOwner under its existing registry lock/availability gate, only when it has a real consumer.

Compose the named concrete retrieval provider from the same opened CognitiveStore and prompt owner plus authenticated external owners after owner startup, before admitting control/App Server traffic. Keep HnmfRequired rejecting absent owners.

Choose explicit body-wide pinned-profile enforcement or a versioned request/turn-specific context contract. Reuse the exact owner cut and existing publication/final-use revalidation rather than weakening or replacing those gates.

Qualify revocation/drift during reads, model/tool-schema replacement, wrong body generation, compact absence/retirement, Engram vector mismatch, owner restart/rollback, and bounded I/O with the real implementations before marking provider integration complete.
delivery_boundary: This audit identifies exact reusable owners and blocking APIs; it is not a production provider, activation receipt, or learning-chain completion claim. The 670/670 native test pass belongs to the already completed native integration cohort, not this still-open HNMF composition.
